notes.title: Update v2.1.0 - "The Game of Squids: Ultimate Parody Game" Collaboration!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25811323/28a6996cca3cc034660080e642aedb7be7246c22.png[/img]

A guest squid from The Game of Squids: Ultimate Parody Game has dropped by! We gave them a decent ladle and an old hat, so now they feel right at home :)

In this small update, I’m excited to introduce a mini-collaboration with The Game of Squids: Ultimate Parody Game!

Changelist:
- Added a new character, "Squidebald"
- Placed a themed item on the main menu table
- Fixed lighting in certain areas
- Adjusted the placement of some buttons in the main menu
- Fixed several minor bugs

notes.title: Major update v2.0 is now available!
notes.content:
Full changelist (although in fact, almost the entire game was remake):

Graphic changes:
	- Game graphics have been completely updated
	- Completely redesigned character animations
	- Updated characters and their styles
	- Some minor characters have been changed
	- Updated decorations on levels
	- Added animations to some objects
	- Fixed and improved lighting in levels
	- Updated textures in the main menu
	- Added shadows and improved graphics in the main menu
	- Updated interface, buttons and character icons
	- Updated game intro
	- Fixed graphic errors

Sound changes:
	- Completely updated music in levels and menus
	- Added new soundtracks
	- Replaced the sound of taking damage
	- Fixed bugs related to music
	- Replaced the music in the Easter egg game

Gameplay changes:
	- Changed the angle and range of the character's camera
	- Updated easter egg game
	- Now instead of character classes their names are displayed
	- Updated campaign completion screen
	- Added new Easter eggs
	- Removed squat animation
	- Removed campaign "Halloween Quest"
	- Removed character "Skeleton"
	- Achievements for the "Halloween Quest" campaign have been removed.
	- Fixed some bugs

Changes to the game in the Steam store:
	- Updated all icons, images and logos of the game
	- Updated icons and names of achievements
	- Updated trailer and screenshots of the game

It was a long journey, but I got it done and brought you this legendary update!
Thank you for still supporting the game :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25811323/5b48e3d735c958e27075519c3e2a3553ee2106fd.png[/img]

notes.title: Painted Legend v2.0 update - In development!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25811323/e3f0d997423ecd56b9ed85046aaca1dc5efe1288.jpg[/img]

Hello!
Today I want to announce the v2.0 update, which has recently been in development, in addition to a new game in the Painted Legend series!
In this update, all graphics, textures and some animations will be completely redesigned. There are also other pleasant little things waiting for you, which I can’t tell you about yet, but I’m sure you’ll like it :)
There is no need to worry about the main gameplay - it will not be particularly affected. This major update will mainly focus on updating and improving the game's graphics.

Please, if you like our game, do not forget to leave a positive review to help promote the game :)
